correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the distance and extremizer proof in actual RESULT.md (blob 4f757a8c). Cartesian geodesics change the K_m coordinate at most once and cross each path cut at most once. Each selected column has at most two longitudinal edges. A double-selected column forces two endpoint-layer incident clique-edge omissions; the exceptional m=t=2 scenario requires an additional interior omission. If there are no double-selected columns, equality forces all clique edges and one longitudinal edge per column; geodesics switching between distinct chosen cuts forbid staggered choices. This covers m=L=2 and every L,m>=2. Independently enumerated geodesic triples and all optimal masks for (m,L)=(2,3),(2,4),(3,2),(3,3), checking unique claimed forms. The finite cases corroborate but do not prove all parameters.
